claims.content: To define and manage the stored operational control command sequences that are executed based on the current system mode of operation and a schedule.

goal.raw_text: To define and manage the stored operational control command sequences that are executed based on the current system mode of operation and a schedule.

claims.content: System Administrator
The System Administrator must be logged into the RLCS Application.
The System Administrator must have the authorized security level and password assigned to their staff member account to access configuration options.
The System Administrator initiates the configuration of operational schedules to define or modify stored operational control command sequences.

trigger.raw_text: The System Administrator initiates the configuration of operational schedules to define or modify stored operational control command sequences.

claims.content: The System Administrator defines the Goal State (e.g., Open South Bound) and Initial State (e.g., Closed) for the schedule.
The System Administrator specifies the scheduled time for the operation sequence to execute (e.g., AM Opening at 5:20 AM).
For each step in the sequence, the System Administrator defines the specific Operation (e.g., CLOSE, OPEN), the target Device (e.g., Gate 1, CMS 9-12), and the Location.
The System Administrator includes a 'Status check by Operator' as the initial verification step for the sequence before device commands are executed.
At any point in an opening or closing sequence, the sequence shall be halted if a device fails to report completion of the current sequence step within the response time window allotted for the step.

At any point in an opening or closing sequence, the sequence shall be halted if the status of a closure device changes to 'unknown' or an unexpected state (e.g., closed when previously opened) without an operator-initiated command.
At any point in an opening sequence, the sequence shall be halted if the status of a closure device for the opposite direction of travel changes to 'unknown' or 'open'.

To resume an opening or closing sequence after a halt has occurred, the operator shall be able to issue a command to resume if the offending device status can be corrected within a configurable time period.
If a scheduled operational sequence requires an operator to be logged on to confirm each step and no operator is logged on, an audible alarm will sound to alert the operator to log on to the system.
